headline: Bottom Le Havre create like Marseille but cannot finish
summary: Le Havre arrive at the Vélodrome 18th in Ligue 1, with 2 points from seven matches and no win. Marseille are only ninth, but last weekend they won 5-2 at Angers, and a year ago this fixture finished 6-2. The gap is narrower than the table suggests: Le Havre average 1.67 expected goals a game, the same as Marseille, yet they have scored only 4 league goals. Across the market, margin removed, Marseille are 60.6% favourites and Le Havre 19.7%. Both teams to score is 57.6%, and the chance of over 3 goals rose to 51.4% from 49.1%.
